answers.core: This approach seems vastly more understandable and consistent than the built-in root_scale options, and is also consistent with the import pipeline of other engines.
answers.workaround: While an importer script could provide similar functionality, I feel this makes sense as a built-in option since I feel it preferential over the existing approach for the reasons I have laid out, and would I feel it does a better job of encouraging the usage of non-destructive workflows.

title: Replace root_scale import option with permanent modification to an imported scene's scale
